content: POL NJAMBƗT KULAA ROMAT YINDƗ

Rom walɨnja ngepmat njaambɨtmba kulaa ay Festas wandɨ mala Pologwi nat kalabusmba la nɨmba kat kwutaa kalindi. Njambwi soldia ndɨna sɨ Julias ndi kat vɨga lɨndɨ. Wan njambwi soldia soldiana nat mbaapmamba lɨndɨ. Wan mbaapmana sɨ Romba lɨga njambwi nyana mbaapma.

Adramitiam walɨnja ngepma yilaa njaambɨt kunɨn. Kulaa yinɨn. Wan njaambɨt Esia walɨnja nɨma kɨpmana ngepma ngepma yigiyaa njaambɨtna. Aristakas nɨnanala yindɨ. Ndɨ Masadoniana nyana. Ndɨna ngepma Tesalonaika.
Nat nandinya Saidon walɨnja ngepma kawinɨn. Wan soldia Julias Pol kat apma vat yindɨ. Ndɨ kat wandɨ. Ngwutna alɨ nɨmba vɨvat ngepma wulei. Mɨn kat kɨgɨnda kwigiyandi waa wandɨ.
Wan ngepma kwaglalaa mwuk ndaama njaambɨt vɨyandɨ maa viyenjingwenda nat yambɨmba yinɨn. Saipras walɨnja nɨmbukna ngwaymba yinɨn. Wan kava mwuk nɨn kat ana viyandɨ.
Yiga nɨma kɨpma Pampilia Silisia waymba lɨga Mira walɨnja ngepmat valigenɨn. Wan ngepma Lisia walɨnja nɨma kɨpmamba lɨgandɨ.
Miramba njambwi soldia Aleksandriamba la yaa njaambɨt vɨndɨ. Wan njambɨt Rom yigiyaa njaambɨt. Wungi kat tɨga nɨn kat kundɨ.
Nandinya kuvut yigumba yilɨnɨn. Nɨma njɨvwa kwuka Naidas kawinɨn. Mbaala mwuk kiyak walɨ ambiange woli mwuk samat kwutndɨ maa Krit walɨnja nɨmbuk valigenɨn Salmoni walɨnja maaga vɨgɨvaa yinɨn.
Tɨvagawi ngwaymba yiga apma Kawinja Kava walɨnja kavamba yiga kawinɨn. Lesia walɨnja ngepma ngwaymba lɨndɨ.
Wan kava nɨma njɨmbla lɨnɨn. Njambɨtmba yilɨnja njɨmbla tamba yindɨ. Wan njɨmbla yineyan ana nglaatndɨ. Judana pesto tamb ngɨlɨndɨ. Wungi kat tɨga Pol laata wandɨ.
Ngwuk kan kava kwagalangweyan kavle vatna. Njaambɨt kavle yigiyandɨ. Ngwutna nat nɨmba kiyaigandi waa wandɨ Pol.

Njambwi soldia Pol waa nyaangɨt wupmak kat kai wandɨ. Njaambɨt kat vɨga la nyan nyaangɨt soldia wutndɨ. Sanya yaagilaa njaambɨt klaa nyan waa nyaangɨt soldia wutndɨ. Mbɨk wambɨt. Yigiyanɨn waa wambɨt.

Nɨma sakwat nɨmba wandi. Tɨlɨna kava kavle kava. Yipma yilɨga njɨmblamba wan kavamba kawilaa tɨvak kat kai wanɨn. Yivat wanɨn waa wandi. Finiks walɨnja ngepma yilaa yipma yilɨga njɨmblamba kawilaa tɨvak wandi. Finiks walɨnja kava Krit walɨnja nɨma nɨmbukmba lɨga njaambɨt kawilɨga kava.
MWUK KWUTNDƗ, PALI NƗMA VAT LAATNDƗ
Kambango woli samat kwutndɨ maa yelavɨtndi. Apma mwukna waa yelavɨtndi. Yelavɨtaa samban yisendalaa yindi. Krit walɨnja nɨmbutna tɨvagawi ngwaymba yindi.
Samat tɨgaambiange woli nɨmamba kwutndɨ. Nɨmamba kwutndɨ, njaambɨt kwutaa kalindɨ, wogwendi. Nɨmamba kwutndɨ, njaambɨt kwutaa kalindɨ, wogwendi.
Mwuk kwutaa kalindɨ wogwenan ana kawinɨn. Nɨma njɨvwa kwutna njɨvwa kwagalanɨn maa mwuk nɨn kat kalindɨ.

Klanda walɨnja mat nɨmbukna ngwaymba yinɨn. Ngwaymba lɨnɨn mwuk samat kiyak wandɨ. Tɨga lɨga yaawi yisendalaa mat dingi njambɨt kunɨn. Yaawi nɨma sakwat yisendala kɨplalagulaa nat naangɨmba kalilaa tunɨn. Libiya walɨnja kɨpmana yawiya kawigiyanɨn waa vaka yelavɨka lɨndi. Wungi kat tɨga sel suwinɨn maa mwuk nɨn kat kalindɨ.
Wan nɨma mwuk ana kiyak wandɨ. Nat nandinya wan njaambɨtmba la kwanda kwanda nat samat ngumba yaagindi.
Nat nandinya njaambɨtna nda taambamba kwutaa ngumba yaagindi.
Nɨma sakwat nandinya nya mbak sɨngwut ana vɨlɨnɨn. Mwuk nɨmamba kwutɨndɨ. Nɨn aywaa kiyaiganɨn waa yelavɨtnɨn.
Njaambɨtmba lɨga nɨmba nao ana kɨlɨndi. Pol laataa wandɨ. Kritmba lɨnɨn wuna nyaangɨt manda kat wutapma yingwuk. Wuka yiga yingwan wan kavle vat nɨn kat ana yaindɨ.
Mbambala ngwuk kat wowun. Ke vaakngwa. Ngwuk ana kiyaigangwuk. Njaambɨt mɨna kavle yigiyandɨ.

Nak ngan Godna ensel yalaa wun kat wandɨ. God wuna nyaekna. Ndɨ kat yelavɨka lɨgowun. Ensel wandɨ wun kat. Pol ke vaaka. Romba lɨga njambwi nyan kat mbukiyamɨn. God ngwuk kat apma vat yindɨ. Mɨnogwinala lɨga nɨmba ana kiyagandi waa wandɨ ensel.
Wungi kat tɨga ke vaaka. God waa nyaangɨk kat wuna mbangɨ wiyo waavi taagalɨgandɨ. Wanda vapmba tɨgiyanɨn waa yelavɨkwun.
Wan mwuk viyandɨ maa yiga nat nɨmbukmba kawigiyanɨn waa wandɨ Pol.
Tamba vɨli kiyeli aynat nandinya yinɨn. Adria walɨna nyɨngi ngumba nɨn kat mwuk kwutaa kalindɨ. Nɨndɨ ngan njaambɨk kat vɨga lɨga nɨmba yelavɨtndi. Tamba yaa nɨmbu kawivat yiganɨn waa yelavɨtndi.

Kɨpma kat sɨga vɨvat yaawi yisendandti. Nguna sɨvla pit ndumi sɨla kɨta tɨdɨ mala vɨndi kɨpmamba ndaigaa taagalaa lɨndɨ. Samat yiga nat jambɨ ak kɨpma kat yisenda vɨndi. Nguna sɨvla pit ndumi aynat kiyeli tamba vlɨi tɨndɨ, vɨndi.
Njambɨt kambak viyavak kat vaatndi. Samban aynat kengwi njaambɨtmba tulaa kɨpma kat kwupmat yisendandi. Nya wokevak kat kawiga lɨndi samban yesendalaa.

Njaambɨt kat vɨga la nɨmba njaambɨt kwagalavat wandi. Ndi woseka waa wandi. Mat dingimba samban ndaama njaambɨtmba kulaa yigiyanɨn waa woseka wandi. Njaambɨt ke mɨna lɨindi maa Pol wandɨ. Pol njambwi soldiagwi nat soldia kat wandɨ. Njaambɨk kat vɨga lɨga nɨmba yinjeyan nɨn aywaa kavle yigiyanɨn waa wandɨ.
Pol wandɨ maa soldia dingi kat tunja yaaw kalɨtndi, ngumba ndaiga dandɨ.

Nya lamba woke mɨna lɨgandɨ, Pol laataa wandɨ. nao agɨ ngwula. nandinya tambavɨli kiyeli aynat kwo lɨngwuk. Nao ana kɨngwuk. Nao kɨlapman yingweyan ngwutna ava ana lɨgiyandɨ. Kavle yigiyangwuk. Ngwuk ana kiyaigangwuk kwo lɨgiyangwuk. Ngwut samat ana kavle yigiyangwuk waa wandɨ Pol.
Pol walaa bret-nao God kat apma vat kwimɨn waa walaa tambɨ lambɨ kalɨtaa kɨndɨ. God kat wanda vat aywaa vɨndi.
pol kɨlɨnda vat vɨlaa ndi vaak vat ngɨlindɨ. Ndino bret-nao klalaa kɨndi.
Njaambɨtmba lɨlɨga nɨmbana sakwat 276.
Nao kɨlaa njaambɨtmba lɨga yuwi sɨk kwutaa nyingi ngumba yaagindi. yaagindi maa njaambɨt wiyaka wokendɨ.
NJAAMBƗT KAVLE YINDƗ
Nya lamba wokendɨ maa njaambɨt kat vɨga lɨga nɨmba kɨpma vɨlaa wandi. Kan anda kavamba kɨpma yalaa vɨna waa wandi. Yaawiya la wumbungu vɨlaa kawivat wandi.

Samban tunja yaaw kalɨtndi mala samban lumaka ndaindi. Kwengwi njaambɨtmba vaala vaglalaa nɨma ngusa tunja yaaw kalɨtndi. Ndaama njaambɨtmba la sel kwutaa katsondi. Katsondi, mwuk kwutaa njaambɨt kat kalindɨ.
Njaambɨt yiga yawiyamba kalakɨtndɨ. Ndɨna ndaamayawiya katsendɨ. Kengwi njaambɨt kwo lɨndɨ. Nɨma pali kengwi njaambɨtmba viyandɨ njaambɨt mbɨlɨndɨ.
Soldia yelavɨtndi. Kalabusmba lɨga yaa nɨmba kat vatnyagiyanɨn. Vatnyalapman yineyan nɨn kat kwagalaa kwo yigiyandi waa yelavɨtndi.
Njambwi soldia Pol kat vatnyavak kat kai wandɨ. Wungi kat tɨga ke vatnyaga wandɨ. Ngu suwutɨga nɨmba ay ngwula ngumba. Nambumba yiga alɨ ngwula.
Ngu suwutapman nɨmba mi klalaa kwutaa ngumba vɨga wuleiga nɨmbu waak ngwula waa wandɨ njambwi soldia. Wupma yiga nɨmbu veilaa kwo lɨndi aywaa.
